action: No security action is needed; Microsoft says this was not an attack. Microsoft 365 customers: confirm that delayed email has arrived, check for service credits under your agreement and review how staff communicate when email is down.
exec: A prolonged email and collaboration outage shows dependence on one cloud supplier; Microsoft says it was not an attack.
impact: Outlook, Teams and Copilot were disrupted in 74 countries; per CyberCube the broader incident lasted about 38 hours.
plain: A fault on November 12 took down Outlook and disrupted Teams, Copilot and other Microsoft services in 74 countries. Microsoft's report says its testing missed the hardware and traffic mix involved; it says this was not an attack.

evidence.quote: "Our testing did not adequately represent the combination of hardware and traffic mix encountered during this incident," Microsoft said in the report.
will most likely total less than $100 mn, according to its preliminary catastrophe analysis.
a conservative upper bound of $350 mn

summary: Outlook, Teams and Copilot were disrupted from 12 November in 74 countries, per Al Jazeera; CyberCube puts the broader incident at about 38 hours. Microsoft first cited a network capacity upgrade, not malicious activity (via Beinsure). CyberCube's preliminary analysis says insured losses will most likely total less than $100 mn, with a conservative upper bound of $350 mn; Acrisure estimates $700 mn.
title: Microsoft 365 outage knocks out Outlook, Teams and Copilot in 74 countries

validation.note: Al Jazeera and Yahoo Finance agree on dates, scope, cause statement and no-cyberattack statement. BleepingComputer returned 403. The earlier 130,000 Downdetector figure could not be confirmed and was removed.

links.rel: named among outages officials say were not an attack
